summary.name: gptimage2.5
summary.one_liner: A web-based AI image generator offering OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5 models (Flare and Sunburst) for text-to-image and reference-image editing at 1K–4K, with a paid credits system after one free try.
use_cases: Creating posters and banners with text
Generating ecommerce product and lifestyle shots
Turning a selfie into professional portrait avatars
Producing social media covers and ad creatives
Editing existing images with natural-language instructions
summary.what_it_does: The site provides text-to-image and reference-image editing using GPT Image 2.5, with Flare as a fast default model and Sunburst for higher-quality output, plus the earlier GPT Image 2 for comparison. Output is offered at 1K, 2K and 4K with per-image credits. A reverse-prompt workflow lets users upload a photo, have the AI describe it as a photography prompt, and generate portraits in chosen styles. The page also hosts a community prompt library and states that prompts can be copied and reused.
notable: Flare (fast) and Sunburst (higher quality) model choice
Reverse-prompt workflow: upload a photo and generate a reusable prompt
One free guest generation without sign-up, no API key needed
caveats: Paid credit packs required after the single free try (Trial, Value and Unlimited packs listed at roughly $0.05, $0.029 and $0.02 per generation)
Page states the site is not OpenAI; the models are described as OpenAI's, and the page does not give independent verification of quality claims
Several capability claims (near-perfect text, photoreal quality) are marketing statements without independent evidence on the page
